title: What actually happens inside a data center?
excerpt: The physical systems behind cloud services, streaming, AI and the modern internet.
body: A data center is a facility designed to run computing and networking equipment continuously. Racks contain servers, storage systems and switches connected through high-capacity networks.
Reliable facilities need redundant electricity, backup power, cooling, fire protection, physical security and multiple network paths.
AI is making data-center design especially important because dense accelerator clusters can require extraordinary amounts of power, cooling and network bandwidth.
